product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - NEMA 5-15P to IEC 60320 C13 14AWG 15A/1875W 125V SJT 3-Prong 2ft Black 6-Pack
product.description: The Monoprice Power Cord with NEMA 5-15P to IEC-320-C13 connectors is a versatile solution for connecting various electronic devices in North America. Designed to work seamlessly with PCs, monitors, scanners, and printers, this power cord ensures a reliable power supply for your equipment. The cord enables you to effortlessly connect devices equipped with a male IEC 60320 C14 panel connector to a standard US AC wall outlet. With a standard, grounded NEMA 5-15P plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C13 female connector on the other, setup becomes hassle-free. Simply link the female C13 connector to your device or power adapter's male C14 connector, and then insert the NEMA plug into an accessible AC power outlet, UPS, or any AC power source. Crafted with 14AWG, the cord offers a sturdy build that can handle up to 15A/1875W power capacity, making it suitable for most applications. Whether it's powering your computer, monitor, or power adapter, this power cord is a reliable companion for everyday use.
